assignedReviews.card_evidence: Springs and wells are examples of groundwater sources
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the characteristics of living things: they grow, respond, and reproduce
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes groundwater sources (springs and wells), which are non-living earth materials. The competency G3-L-3 requires describing characteristics of living things (grow, respond, reproduce). The card provides no information about living things or their characteristics, so it is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Springs and wells are examples of groundwater sources where water from beneath the Earth's surface comes out for people to use.
copy.tl: Ang mga spring at well ay mga halimbawa ng groundwater sources kung saan lumalabas ang tubig mula sa ilalim ng Earth's surface para magamit ng mga tao.
copy.bis: Ang mga spring ug well mga pananglitan sa groundwater sources diin mogawas ang tubig gikan sa ilalom sa Earth's surface para magamit sa mga tawo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Household substances like vinegar, baking soda, lemon, and bleaching solution can remove stains because they react with the stain.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe different types of collisions as elastic or inelastic by providing some examples
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses household stain removers and chemical reactions, which is unrelated to the competency about describing elastic and inelastic collisions. No physics content about collisions is present.

copy.en: Household substances like vinegar, baking soda, lemon, and bleaching solution can remove stains because they react with the stain.
copy.tl: Ang mga gamit sa bahay tulad ng suka, baking soda, lemon, at bleaching solution ay nakakapagtanggal ng mantsa dahil nagre-react sila sa mantsa.
copy.bis: Ang mga gamit sa balay sama sa suka, baking soda, lemon, ug bleaching solution makapawala sa mansa tungod kay mo-react kini sa mansa.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Standard SI units like meter, kilogram, and second
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains standard SI units for measuring length, mass, and time. This is unrelated to identifying basic needs of living things such as air, food, water, and shelter.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scientists around the world use standard SI units so that measurements of mass, length, volume, time, and temperature mean the same thing everywhere.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate through guided investigation the advantages and limitations of simple machines, such as inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about standard SI units for measurement, not about simple machines, their advantages/limitations, or guided investigations of them. No instructional support for G6-F-2.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scientists around the world use standard SI units so that measurements of mass, length, volume, time, and temperature mean the same thing everywhere.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe examples and uses of simple machines found at home, at school, and in the community
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses standard SI units, not examples or uses of simple machines at home, school, or community. Unrelated to G6-F-1.

copy.en: Scientists around the world use standard SI units so that measurements of mass, length, volume, time, and temperature mean the same thing everywhere.
copy.tl: Gumagamit ang mga scientist sa buong mundo ng standard SI units para pareho ang ibig sabihin ng sukat ng mass, length, volume, time, at temperature kahit saan.
copy.bis: Ang mga scientist sa tibuok kalibutan naggamit ug standard SI units aron pareho ug kahulugan ang sukod sa mass, length, volume, time, ug temperature bisan asa.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Translation begins at a start codon, usually AUG, and ends when the ribosome reaches a stop codon
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how soil is formed from rocks and minerals
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains translation and start/stop codons in protein synthesis, which is molecular biology. G5-E-4 requires explaining how soil is formed from rocks and minerals, a completely unrelated Earth science topic. The card provides no instructional support for soil formation.

copy.en: Translation begins at a start codon, usually AUG, and ends when the ribosome reaches a stop codon that signals the protein chain is complete.
copy.tl: Nagsisimula ang translation sa start codon, karaniwang AUG, at nagtatapos kapag narating ng ribosome ang stop codon na hudyat na kumpleto na ang protein chain.
copy.bis: Ang translation magsugod sa start codon, kasagarang AUG, ug matapos kon maabot sa ribosome ang stop codon nga senyales nga kompleto na ang protein chain.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A scientific investigation begins with a problem or question that can be solved through experimentation
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify which groups of animals reproduce by giving birth to live young, such as mammals, and which reproduce by laying eggs, such as birds and reptiles
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses what makes a good science question and the start of a scientific investigation. It has no content about animal reproduction, live birth, or egg-laying groups, which is the subject of G5-L-5.

copy.en:
What makes a good science question?

A scientific investigation begins with a problem or question that can be solved through experimentation, not just by looking up the answer!
copy.tl:
Ano ang gumagawa ng magandang tanong sa science?

Nagsisimula ang isang scientific investigation sa isang problema o tanong na masasagot sa pamamagitan ng eksperimento, hindi lang sa pagtingin ng sagot!
copy.bis:
Unsa ang naghimo sa maayong pangutana sa science?

Ang usa ka scientific investigation magsugod sa problema o pangutana nga masulbad pinaagi sa eksperimento, dili lang sa pagpangita sa tubag!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains microscope focusing technique (starting with low power objective), which is unrelated to uniform/non-uniform mixtures, solutions, or suspensions. This is a microscope skill, not a matter/mixtures competency.

copy.en:
Why should you start focusing with the lowest power objective?

It gives a wider view, so you can find your specimen first before zooming in with higher power lenses.
copy.tl:
Bakit dapat magsimula sa lowest power objective kapag nag-focus?

Mas malawak ang nakikita nito, kaya mahahanap mo muna ang specimen bago mag-zoom in gamit ang mas matataas na power lenses.
copy.bis:
Ngano magsugod man sa lowest power objective kung mag-focus?

Mas lapad ang makita, busa makit-an una nimo ang specimen sa dili pa mag-zoom in gamit ang mas taas nga power lenses.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the stationary object's initial velocity is zero, so its starting momentum is also zero
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about momentum in a collision, a physics concept. It provides no information about the basic needs of living things (air, food, water, shelter).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the stationary object's initial velocity is zero, so its starting momentum is also zero
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that water is one of the basic needs of plants and animals
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about momentum, not about water as a basic need of plants and animals. It is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: When a moving object hits a stationary one and they stick together, the stationary object's initial velocity is zero, so its starting momentum is also zero.
copy.tl: Kapag ang gumagalaw na bagay ay tumama sa nakatigil na bagay at magdikit sila, ang initial velocity ng nakatigil na bagay ay zero, kaya zero rin ang panimulang momentum nito.
copy.bis: Kung ang naglihok nga butang moigo sa nagpundo nga butang ug magtapot sila, ang initial velocity sa nagpundo nga butang kay zero, busa zero usab ang sinugdanan nga momentum nito.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how relative and absolute dating techniques are used to determine the subdivisions of geologic time
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the steps of a scientific investigation (problem, hypothesis, data, analysis, conclusion). It has no content about relative or absolute dating techniques or subdivisions of geologic time.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate how erosion transports Earth materials
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the scientific investigation process, not about erosion or how erosion transports Earth materials.

copy.en: A scientific investigation is a step-by-step process that includes an aim or problem, materials and equipment, method or procedures, results including data, and conclusions.
copy.tl: Ang scientific investigation ay isang prosesong may mga hakbang: aim o problem, materials and equipment, method o procedures, results kasama ang data, at conclusions.
copy.bis: Ang scientific investigation usa ka proseso nga adunay mga lakang: aim o problem, materials and equipment, method o procedures, results apil ang data, ug conclusions.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Keep flammable materials, breakable items, and toxic chemicals in a safe place before an earthquake.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify some of the basic characteristics used to describe the weather, such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rain, and cloud cover
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about earthquake preparedness (storing dangerous items), which has no relation to identifying weather characteristics such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rain, or cloud cover. The assigned competency is entirely about weather descriptors, so the card does not support it.

copy.en: Keep flammable materials, breakable items, and toxic chemicals in a safe place before an earthquake.
copy.tl: Itago sa ligtas na lugar ang mga flammable materials, madaling mabasag na gamit, at toxic chemicals bago lumindol.
copy.bis: Itago sa luwas nga lugar ang mga flammable materials, dali mabuak nga mga butang, ug toxic chemicals sa dili pa molinog.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A storm surge can push sea waves up to 5 meters high
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of DNA, genes, and chromosomes in the transmission of traits
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes storm surge height, a weather/ocean phenomenon. G9-L-2 requires explaining the role of DNA, genes, and chromosomes in trait transmission. There is no genetic or heredity content, so the tag is unrelated.

copy.en:
How high can a storm surge be?

A storm surge can push sea waves up to 5 meters high, which is taller than a one-story house!
copy.tl:
Gaano kataas ang storm surge?

Kayang itulak ng storm surge ang mga alon sa dagat hanggang 5 metro ang taas, na mas mataas pa sa isang palapag na bahay!
copy.bis:
Unsa kataas ang storm surge?

Ang storm surge makatulak sa mga balod sa dagat hangtod sa 5 metros ang kataas, nga mas taas pa sa usa ka andana nga balay!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Public Storm Warning Signals indicate lead time, wind speed range, and expected wind damage before a tropical cyclone arrives.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe the possible effects of human activities, such as deforestation, pollution, and introduction of invasive species, on living things in an ecosystem
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes storm warning signals, a weather/earth science topic. The competency requires describing effects of human activities (deforestation, pollution, invasive species) on living things in an ecosystem. There is no connection to human activities or ecosystem effects.

copy.en: Public Storm Warning Signals indicate lead time, wind speed range, and expected wind damage before a tropical cyclone arrives.
copy.tl: Ang Public Storm Warning Signals ay nagsasabi ng lead time, saklaw ng lakas ng hangin, at inaasahang pinsala bago dumating ang bagyo.
copy.bis: Ang Public Storm Warning Signals nagpaila sa lead time, gidak-on sa kusog sa hangin, ug gipaabot nga kadaot sa dili pa moabot ang bagyo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During stormy weather, stay indoors, keep away from windows, and listen to the radio for safety updates.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes safety actions during stormy weather. It contains no information about chemical properties of materials (burning, reactivity, degradability).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During stormy weather, stay indoors, keep away from windows, and listen to the radio for safety updates.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate ways to minimize harmful changes in materials, such as restriction of burning of waste materials, and care in handling reactive materials
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about storm safety, not about minimizing harmful changes in materials such as restricting burning of waste or handling reactive materials.

copy.en: During stormy weather, stay indoors, keep away from windows, and listen to the radio for safety updates.
copy.tl: Tuwing mabagyo ang panahon, manatili sa loob ng bahay, lumayo sa mga bintana, at makinig sa radyo para sa mga balita tungkol sa kaligtasan.
copy.bis: Kung bagyohon ang panahon, pabilin sa sulod sa balay, palayo sa mga bintana, ug paminaw sa radyo alang sa mga balita mahitungod sa kaluwasan.
